PART VI.  PEDDLERS

 

Note

 

  Section 445-141 designated as Part VI by L 1990, c 164, §28.

 

     §445-141  Licensing.  Each council shall have the power to enact ordinances providing for the licensing and regulation of any person who peddles merchandise. [L 1907, c 96, pt of §1; am L 1917, c 122, §1; am L 1923, c 111, §1; RL 1925, §2077; RL 1935, §2498; am L 1935, c 182, §1; am L 1939, c 109, §1; RL 1945, §7102; am L 1953, c 230, §1; am L 1955, c 193, §1; RL 1955, §155-82; HRS §445-141; am L 1978, c 182, §2; am L 1990, c 164, §22]

 

Case Notes

 

  License a tax, when.  36 H. 661 (1944).
